landing.text:
HEADLINE
Ensure regulatory readiness for Series A fintech startups

SUBHEADLINE
For fintech startup founders, regulators' demands overwhelm compliance processes.

WHAT THIS IS
A guided onboarding assistant that explains risk, completes KYC, and helps new investors start their first SIP.

WHO IT IS FOR
Fintech startup founders

THE PROBLEM
Regulators' demands overwhelm compliance processes

WHY EXISTING TOOLS FAIL
Spreadsheets and manual document management was not designed for fintech startup founders. It covers the broader category but lacks the specific mechanics this problem requires, forcing fintech startup founders to patch gaps with manual workarounds that slow outcomes.

HOW IT WORKS
Streamlines regulatory documentation with AI-assisted templates.

KEY BENEFITS
Early users of Compliance Document Organizer reach their first outcome without the overhead of general-purpose alternatives.

CALL TO ACTION
Get started with Compliance Document Organizer.

ux.text:
UX CONTEXT
TARGET: product
Compliance Document Organizer helps fintech startup founders understand risk, complete KYC, and start their first investment with confidence.

ONBOARDING
1. Answer a few questions to understand your financial situation.
2. Complete your verification so Compliance Document Organizer can personalise your plan.
3. Start your first investment and track your progress.

EMPTY STATE
1. No risk profile yet. Complete the questionnaire to get started.
2. No investments set up yet. Finish setup to see your plan.
3. No transactions yet. Make your first investment to see activity.

ERROR
1. That did not save. Check your input and try again.
2. That step did not complete. Make sure all required fields are filled in.
3. This action failed. Reload and try again, or contact support if it continues.

TOAST
1. Saved. Your progress is recorded.
2. Done. Continue when you are ready.
3. Profile complete. Your plan is ready.

BUTTON LABELS
1. Learn My Risk
2. Complete KYC
3. Start My SIP
4. Review Plan
5. View Portfolio
6. Confirm Details
7. Update Risk Profile
8. Track Progress
